tombstoneInscriptions: The king never walked upon the earth.
He climbed the mountain alone, and returned wearing a crown no smith had forged.
Three nights later, the priests declared that the gods had chosen him.
He was not chosen. He was shown.
To hear the ring is to live again.
A monarch is born noble. Why would he need to climb?
campfireInspections: Cold ash. The fire died in a hurry.
The wood is blackened, but barely burned.
Whoever has called this place home has long abandoned it.
skeletonInspections: The corpse lies twisted in the dirt.
Something tore the flesh from the bones.
The bones bear strange bite marks.
Whatever killed them left little behind.
The dead body have been here a long time.
A crude death. A lonely grave.
